purpose: Current online/competitor research plus sealed-product/GitHub/live-state triangulation for attorney launch readiness.

observedState.liveAuditConstraint: The independent web-reading channel did not reliably resolve smarterjustice.com before deployment. Do not fabricate a fresh page-body audit; exact public live acceptance is mandatory after deployment.

competitorEvidence.observed: Leads with concrete outcomes attorneys understand: organized intake, less manual work, progress visibility, reputation, source/channel insight and client experience.
competitorEvidence.use: Lead Smarter Justice attorney pages with immediate outcomes and demonstrable value rather than internal architecture terms.

competitorEvidence.observed: Explains intake through simple actions and benefits: collect information, reduce re-entry, see who needs follow-up and track lead source.
competitorEvidence.use: Keep attorney-facing language concrete and task-oriented.

competitorEvidence.observed: Explains lead management through a visible prospective-client pipeline, online forms, follow-up, consultations and marketing-channel tracking.
competitorEvidence.use: Show a clear attorney journey and next action without promising unqualified operating functions.

competitorEvidence.observed: Uses direct growth language and emphasizes knowing what happened to leads, revenue intelligence and one-place visibility.
competitorEvidence.use: Make Smarter Justice differentiation understandable at a glance while avoiding guaranteed-growth claims and avoiding features not yet qualified.

competitorEvidence.observed: Emphasizes connecting marketing-related source/status data while avoiding sensitive case-file content in the marketing integration.
competitorEvidence.use: Preserve privacy-minimized attribution principles; do not require a private matter narrative merely to understand source.

buildDecisions.item: Rewrite attorney demo surfaces in simple benefit-first language while preserving truth labels.
Replace internal terms such as suppression, native/external-primary and purpose-limited access on attorney-visible tour surfaces.

Make the 7-step attorney demonstration prove working public legal areas, Navigator, professional profile path, preparation tools and fail-closed marketing preflight rather than advertising unfinished future modules.
Repair mobile Menu behavior and make phone navigation a release acceptance surface.
Slightly reduce oversized desktop/laptop hero typography without redesigning working visual identity.
Add working-only public publication gate and remove ordinary links to preserved unfinished routes.
Add zero-loss operational data continuity, backup/restore and migration fail-closed requirements.
One-platform Smarter Justice legal-area model; no return to public micro-portal navigation.
Pre49 remains last accepted-live rollback authority until pre52 passes live acceptance.
Competitor trade-dress copying, guaranteed-growth claims, blanket compliance claims, or presentation of gated features as live.
